_note: Every number, ID and rule for the Churn Analysis refresh. Changed only by commit. Why: T-tools/02-workflows/churn-analysis-weekly-refresh.md

window._note: Required by the shared run helpers; Churn uses calendar YTD and month-to-date from the run date.

target._managed_note: The refresh owns these fields. Base44 drops unknown field names, so nothing new is ever added; every value is recomputed from the accounts list.

health_source._note: At Risk = Client Health composite band Red (composite_score_partial.band). HubSpot company IDs come from the newest Client Health hs_account_match.json; segment from rubric_segment_column via segment_map (matched 9/9 rows on 2026-10-29).

hubspot._pipelines: 2313721535 New logo, 2313830082 Upsell / Expansion. ACV = sum of Closed Won deal amounts in these pipelines (the deal amount field; hs_acv / hs_arr / acv are unused).
hubspot._segment_note: HubSpot 'SMB (<100)' has always been shown as 'SMB (<250)' on this page (39/39 churned accounts, 2026-11-12).
hubspot.product_rule: DecisionAssist in findigs_products__c -> DA; else Screening -> FS; else Unknown

rejected_company_ids.166598771396: Bluewater Property Management: confirmed false positive 2026-09-24 (churn stamp cleared 2026-08-07; HubSpot flag never fixed)

new_churns._decision: Will, 2026-11-12: auto-add a HubSpot company with churned=true whose churn date is within auto_add_window_days of the run date, unless it is rejected, its status contradicts the churn, a Closed Won deal is dated after the churn date, its segment is unmapped, or its churn_reason is not in the taxonomy. Everything else (older flags, contradicted ones) is listed in the report as a candidate. To add a candidate, put its HubSpot company ID in approved_additions with a note, by commit. Nothing is ever removed automatically.
new_churns._ftl_decision: Will, 2026-11-12: the old rule that turned Failure-to-Launch accounts stale 6+ months into Churned is propose-only.

taxonomy._coverage_note: reason_source_coverage keeps its 4-key schema; sigma_reason_at_risk accounts count under 'none' (2026-10-29 decision).

validation._note: Stop if more than this many accounts enter or leave At Risk in one run (likely a Client Health problem).

at_risk_acv_overrides._note: HubSpot company ID -> approved ACV for a new At Risk account with more than hubspot.max_deals_before_flag Closed Won deals (otherwise pushed as $0 and flagged). Add by commit.
